products.title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen)
products.description: Experience immersive, personalized sound with the Bose QuietComfort Ultra headphones. Featuring breakthrough spatial audio, these wireless headphones create a natural, live-sounding music experience by placing audio in front of you. CustomTune technology analyzes your ear's unique shape to adapt the audio performance for a perfect fit. Crafted with premium materials, including soft ear cushions and an evenly distributing headband, these headphones offer refined comfort. Sleek metal arms add a statement of sophisticated design. Connect seamlessly with advanced Bluetooth 5.3 and manage devices, settings, and features like Adjustable EQ via the Bose app. Enjoy crystal-clear calls with noise-rejecting microphones that focus on your voice.

products.title: Bose Quietcomfort Ultra Headphones
products.description: Experience legendary sound with the Bose QuietComfort Ultra (2nd Gen) Headphones. These next-generation headphones offer an enhanced listening experience with improved noise cancellation, immersive audio modes, premium materials, and effortless playback. Featuring advanced ActiveSense technology, they adapt to noise spikes for unparalleled quiet. Choose from various listening modes including Quiet Mode for complete noise cancellation, Aware Mode to let in ambient sound, or Bose Immersive Audio for a spatialized, front-row listening experience. The new Cinema Mode brings a movie-theater quality to your video content. CustomTune technology personalizes the audio to the unique shape of your ears for optimal performance. The updated design combines sleek aesthetics with plush, comfortable materials, including soft ear cushions and an evenly distributing headband. Constructed with refined metal accents and a premium polished finish, these headphones are both stylish and durable. Effortlessly control your audio, calls, and settings through the intuitive Bose app, which also allows for customizable EQ and shortcuts. Enjoy up to 30 hours of playback in Quiet and Aware modes (23 hours with Immersive Audio), with the added convenience of listening while charging.
